result.summary: Replaces the Boost.Test library with a custom in-tree C++ unit test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new runner introduces expression decomposition to display operand values automatically upon assertion failures, while preserving legacy BOOST_* macro shims to prevent merge conflicts. Boost.Test is removed from depends, Guix, vcpkg, and CMake build configuration.
result.problem: Boost.Test introduces external build and packaging complexity across depends and Guix, interferes with tooling such as IWYU and clang-tidy, and has suffered from platform bugs like undersized signal stacks. Furthermore, its variety of assertion macros (BOOST_CHECK, BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL, BOOST_TEST) handle operand value reporting inconsistently, complicating test debugging.
evidence: Replacing Boost Test has been an open objective discussed in RFC #34666 and issue #8670.
Author notes practical issues with Boost.Test signal stack sizing previously addressed in #36045.
Author notes Boost.Test complicates depends and Guix packaging and hinders clang-tidy/IWYU integration across tests.

enables: Incremental migration of unit tests from legacy BOOST_* macros to native CHECK, REQUIRE, and TEST_CASE macros.

result.scope_notes: The vast majority of the 167 modified files are mechanical single-line include changes applied via a scripted diff. The primary substantive logic is in the newly introduced framework files (src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}, totaling ~1,240 lines).
result.changed_since_previous: Added commits to resolve CI failures, including inlining CRecipient construction to bypass a GCC 12 uninitialized variable warning, addressing a clang-tidy warning in miniminer_tests, and removing rarely used macros like BOOST_FAIL and BOOST_TEST_INFO.
result.card: This PR replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree test runner and assertion framework implemented in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Boost.Test adds packaging and build overhead across depends and Guix, conflicts with tools like clang-tidy and IWYU, and has inconsistent value reporting across assertion macros. Replacing the Boost test framework has been discussed across RFC #34666 and issue #8670, with signal stack workarounds required as recently as #36045. Most file changes are mechanical include updates handled by a scripted diff, while backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims avoid disrupting concurrent pull requests. Boost.Test is completely dropped from CMake, Guix, depends, and vcpkg.

risk.why: Bugs in the custom test framework could produce false passes or mask test failures in CI.
